model.description: In House brings you the legendary Maui Wowie in a convenient 1g All-In-One disposable cartridge, capturing the essence of this iconic tropical sativa. Known for its uplifting and energetic effects, Maui Wowie delivers a blissful experience that sparks creativity and happiness while keeping you focused throughout the day. This strain's vibrant flavor profile features sweet pineapple, citrus, and tropical notes that transport you straight to the Hawaiian islands with every puff. The disposable vape format offers ultimate portability and ease of use—no charging, no refilling, just pure enjoyment. Perfect for daytime adventures, social gatherings, or creative pursuits, this 1g cartridge provides smooth, flavorful vapor from start to finish. Experience the island vibes and euphoric effects that have made Maui Wowie a timeless favorite among cannabis enthusiasts.
